snippet.title: HyperShot Trailer
snippet.description:
Buy HyperShot on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1516600/HyperShot/



The  more enemies you shoot, the more enemies spawn!



Blast your way through 300 levels of replicating orbs that move around trying to kill you.

- 15 boss battles

- Over 20 enemy types.

- Rapidfire weapon

- Unlimited lives

- Replay previous levels.
